  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P, touches src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp, and addresses connection and socket event handling in CConnman.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents nodes from entering a busy-spin loop when TCP urgent data arrives on established connections monitored with select(). Without this change, unread out-of-band data continuously trips the exception set, causing high CPU burn and stalling connection progress."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touch to src/httpserver.cpp is an internal adaptation of HTTP socket disconnection handling; it does not alter any RPC, REST, or ZMQ interfaces or behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental changes to HTTP server socket polling follow the core socket event refactor and do not change RPC functionality or client-facing interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in test/functional/test_framework/netutil.py and test_framework.py solely support p2p_socket_errors.py to pin networking behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Framework edits are minor helpers for a P2P-specific socket error test, which belongs to the P2P area rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the shared Sock abstraction in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp by introducing ConnErrorEventFlag to Sock::Wait().",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Improves the shared Sock wrapper by restricting exception set monitoring to connection establishment. This corrects event-waiting semantics across callers without requiring workaround flags like SO_OOBINLINE."
    }
  ],

  }
